The input is a list of tuples containing the dispute subject and duration, and the output is the number of successfully scheduled disputes.

title: Film Studio Production
spec: Create a function `produce(scripts)` that organizes shooting schedules for a movie lot. Build a studio entity that manages soundstage entities and filming crew entities. Soundstage entities record their square footage and current booking status. Filming crew entities track their personnel count and their required filming days. The studio evaluates each script request, assigns a crew entity, and searches for an available soundstage that is large enough for the personnel count. Once assigned, the soundstage booking status flips to occupied. The input provides a list of required personnel counts and days for various scripts, and the output must be a list of soundstage occupancy states after all requests are processed.

title: Botanical Garden Irrigation
spec: Design a function `water(readings)` that controls a greenhouse moisture system. The structure needs a central controller entity that monitors several sector entities. Each sector entity contains its own threshold value, a current soil moisture level, and a valve status flag. The central controller updates the moisture level of each sector based on incoming sensor data. If a sector level drops below its designated threshold, the sector entity must flip its valve status flag to true to begin irrigation, otherwise it resets to false. The function receives a list of lists, where each inner list contains moisture readings for a specific sector, and returns a list of final valve status flags for all sectors.

title: Drone Swarm Mapping
spec: Implement a function `survey(grid)` that coordinates autonomous flying units over a terrain layout. Establish a central command entity that directs multiple autonomous flyer entities. Each flyer entity stores its current battery life, its assigned altitude, and a list of scanned coordinates. The command entity processes a sequence of target coordinates and assigns each one to a flyer entity that has enough battery life remaining to reach the location. Traveling to a coordinate and scanning it depletes the battery by a set rate. The function takes a list of integer coordinate pairs and returns the total number of unique coordinates successfully scanned by the entire group.

title: Tsunami Warning Buoys
spec: Write a function `monitor(waves)` that processes ocean pressure changes to predict anomalies. The model consists of a network entity that aggregates data from multiple floating sensor entities. Each sensor entity maintains a baseline pressure value and a danger threshold. The network entity feeds incoming pressure updates to the respective sensors. When a sensor receives an update, it checks the difference against its baseline; if the difference exceeds the danger threshold, the sensor generates a localized warning signal. The network entity collects these signals and counts them. The function takes a list of pressure readings and returns the total number of warning signals generated across all sensors.

title: Subway Network Routing
spec: Create a function `dispatch(events)` that simulates an underground rail system. The implementation requires a transit authority entity overseeing multiple rail route entities. Each rail route entity manages a fleet of carriage entities and maintains a total delay counter. Carriage entities track their current station index and passenger load. The transit authority processes passenger boarding and track obstacle events. Boarding events increase a carriage load, while track obstacle events increase the delay counter of the specific rail route entity. The function accepts a list of passenger counts and obstacle time penalties, and returns the delay counter for each rail route after processing the sequence.

title: Catering Banquet Setup
spec: Design a function `seat(roster)` that arranges attendees at a large dining function. The simulation needs a coordinator entity that creates and manages round dining surface entities. Each dining surface entity has a fixed seating capacity and a designated dietary restriction category. The coordinator entity processes a list of attendee entities, each having a name and a dietary preference. The coordinator attempts to place each attendee at a dining surface that matches their preference and has an open seat. If placed, the surface capacity is reduced by one. The function takes a list of attendee preference strings and returns the number of empty seats remaining at each dining surface.

title: Patient Pharmacy Dispenser
spec: Implement a function `dispense(prescriptions)` that manages medication delivery in a clinic. The design must feature a central dispensary entity, several care unit entities, and individual receiver entities. A receiver entity tracks its required dosage amount and current health status. A care unit entity groups multiple receivers and keeps a tally of fulfilled deliveries. The central dispensary validates incoming medication requests against available inventory and sends them to the appropriate care unit. If inventory permits, the care unit applies the dosage to the receiver, improving their health status. The function processes a list of dosage integers and returns a list showing the final health status of all receivers.

title: Medieval Castle Defense
spec: Write a function `defend(assaults)` that simulates a siege scenario. Create a stronghold entity that coordinates several perimeter wall entities. Each wall entity controls a group of defender entities and tracks its structural integrity. Defender entities store their arrow supply and accuracy rating. The stronghold evaluates incoming assault waves, determining which wall entity is targeted. The targeted wall orders its defenders to expend arrows to repel the assault, lowering their supply. If a wall runs out of arrows across all its defenders, its structural integrity takes damage. The function accepts a list of targeted wall indices and assault strengths, returning the remaining structural integrity of each wall.

title: Wizard Dueling Tournament
spec: Create a function `compete(matches)` that models a magical school competition. The system involves an organizer entity overseeing faction entities and participant entities. Each participant entity has a skill rating and an energy level. Faction entities aggregate the scores of their respective participants. The organizer pairs participants for a challenge based on incoming match data. During a challenge, the participant with the higher skill rating wins and gains points for their faction, while both lose energy. If a participant has zero energy, they automatically forfeit. The function processes a list of challenge pairings and returns the final accumulated score for each faction entity.

title: Corporate Hierarchy Planner
spec: Design a function `restructure(budgets)` that handles internal financial allocations. You must implement a corporate entity that contains multiple division entities. Each division entity manages a roster of staff entities and an operating fund. Staff entities maintain their base salary and a performance multiplier. The corporate entity distributes incoming financial packages to the divisions based on their current operating fund deficits. The divisions then iterate through their staff, applying a salary increase calculated from the performance multiplier, which reduces the division operating fund. The input is a list of monetary amounts, and the output is the final operating fund balance for each division.

title: University Course Registration
spec: Implement a function `enroll(requests)` that automates a college sign up period. The logic requires a central admin entity, subject area entities, and class entities. Each class entity has a maximum roster size and a list of enrolled student identifiers. Subject area entities group related class entities. The admin entity receives sign up attempts containing a student identifier and a target class code. It routes the attempt to the relevant subject area, which attempts to add the student to the class. If the roster size is at maximum, the attempt is rejected. The function takes a list of student and class code pairs and returns the number of successful additions.

title: Internet Router Simulation
spec: Write a function `route(traffic)` that models data transmission across digital pathways. The structure needs a central internetwork entity that maintains a collection of gateway entities. Each gateway entity possesses a routing dictionary and a buffer queue for holding transmission fragments. A transmission fragment entity stores its source, destination, and payload data. The internetwork entity injects fragments into the appropriate initial gateway. Gateways then inspect the destination and forward the fragment to the next gateway found in their routing dictionary, updating their buffer queue. The input is a list of destination and payload string tuples, and the output is the final size of the buffer queue at the ultimate destination gateway.

title: Space Station Power Grid
spec: Create a function `balance(fluctuations)` that regulates electricity distribution in an orbital facility. The architecture must include a central grid entity, generator entities, and habitation sector entities. Each generator entity produces a set wattage, while habitation sector entities consume wattage based on their active life support tier. The central grid collects total produced wattage and attempts to satisfy the consumption demands of all habitation sectors. If total demand exceeds production, the grid instructs sectors to lower their life support tier to conserve electricity. The function processes a list of integers representing temporary drops in generator output and returns the final active life support tier of each sector.

title: Multiplayer Arena Team Manager
spec: Design a function `resolve(actions)` that resolves a virtual combat scenario. Implement an arena entity that holds two opposing group entities. Each group entity consists of several champion entities. A champion entity tracks its current health, attack power, and defense rating. The arena entity interprets a sequence of attack commands, determining the attacking champion and the receiving champion. The receiving champion reduces its health by an amount equal to the attack power minus its defense rating. If health falls below zero, the champion is marked as defeated. The input provides a list of attacker and target index pairs, and the output is the count of surviving champions in each group.

title: Financial Portfolio Manager
spec: Implement a function `trade(orders)` that processes equity market transactions. Create a main wealth tracker entity that oversees multiple account entities. Each account entity holds a cash balance and a collection of holding entities. A holding entity records a ticker symbol and the number of shares owned. The wealth tracker processes buy and sell instructions by finding the appropriate account entity and updating its cash balance and holding share counts based on a fixed transaction price. If an account lacks sufficient cash for a buy instruction, the transaction is skipped. The function takes a list of ticker symbols, transaction types, and share quantities, returning the final cash balance of all accounts.

title: Pharmaceutical Compounding Lab
spec: Write a function `synthesize(formulas)` that models a chemical preparation workflow. The system requires a main facility entity that manages worker entities and mixture entities. Each worker entity tracks its safety certification level and current hourly shift. A mixture entity requires a specific safety level to handle and tracks its completion status. The facility assigns incoming mixture requirements to an available worker entity whose safety certification meets or exceeds the requirement. Once assigned, the worker hourly shift increases and the mixture completion status becomes true. The input is a list of integers representing required safety levels, and the output is a list of shift hours for each worker.

title: Concert Hall Acoustics
spec: Create a function `calibrate(sounds)` that adjusts audio equipment for a live performance space. The architecture involves a building entity, several seating zone entities, and audio sensor entities. Each audio sensor entity records a base volume and a clarity metric. A seating zone entity contains multiple audio sensors and calculates an average volume. The building entity iterates over incoming volume spikes, sending them to the specified seating zone, which updates its audio sensors by increasing their base volume. If a sensor base volume exceeds a safe threshold, its clarity metric degrades. The function processes a list of zone identifiers and volume spike integers, returning the average clarity metric for each seating zone.
